purpose: Resolve only the collection path for the contiguous 031154-031261 SAW3 identity cluster after the frozen fd06 path stopped.
method: One-byte HTTP range probes against the exact first and last cluster identities under fd05 and fd06.
bounded_use: The probe permits only the frozen fd05 path override for this contiguous identity cluster. Every downloaded label must still declare flight day 5; the probe does not admit image payloads or infer acquisition time.
